policy_kwargs.note: SB3 SAC default; train.build_model does not set policy_kwargs

curriculum.note: Same replicated schedule as the PPO baseline, so the two are directly comparable. See BASELINES_NOTES.md section 6.

environment.class: CurriculumASVLidarEnv (subclass of ASVLidarEnv, adds only a stage setter)

relationship_to_published_model: Independent retrain. Does not replace models/sac_model_1M.zip, which remains the manuscript's artifact.
deviation_from_published_config: gradient_steps=4 instead of 1. With 8 workers this gives ~4/8 gradient updates per environment transition, against 1/8 in the published config. Standard SAC practice is one update per transition. This is a HYPERPARAMETER change only -- the environment, reward and observation are untouched. Testing whether the gap between from-scratch retrains (0.78-0.84) and the deployed policy (0.950) is an under-training artifact. See BASELINES_RESULTS.md section 4a.
